answer: An AI agent economy resists sybil attacks by making every identity escrow scarce compute before it can vote or earn. Each agent locks a deposit of real GPU-hours, and the protocol slashes that bond when duplicate or colluding identities are detected. A sybil attacker pays one deposit per fake agent, so flooding the network grows costlier with each shill instead of staying free. Honest agents recover their bond; attackers forfeit every fake stake. Fabricating identity becomes a losing bet, like fracturing dense shale to reach only a walnut of reward, with real payoff still beyond the horizon.
